evidence: No source is cited, and the figure depends on the metric used. Global port throughput is roughly 850-900 million TEU moves a year, while loaded containers in trade number far fewer (about 180-200 million TEU). The count of 'containers' is not defined. Neither the CTU Code nor ISO 1496-1 gives this number.

14 claims checked, 13 correct. Verified against MSC.1/Circ.1497 §6.2.5: 'anchor points at the bottom have a MSL of at least 10 kN in any direction. Recently built freight containers have, in many cases, anchor points with a MSL of 20 kN. The lashing points at the top side rails have a MSL of at least 5 kN'. Its footnote 8 cites ISO 1496-1:2013 Annex C. Also checked against IM5 §5.3 (eye ≥ lashing MSL; 1.4 x MSL for both half-loop ends on one eye). The examples recompute (2,000 belt on 1,000 point → 1,000; on 500 → 500; 2 x 4,000 on two 500 eyes → 1,000; up to 4x lashings). The Cubestow version note (1.1.79~) was not checked.
